title: fix(client,platform-objects,docs): in-system copy says "this system", not "this environment" (cloud#3002 ruling A)
body:
Fixes #24456

Clause-②: no (copy only: TSDoc, two hand-written docs pages and three translated help values; no accept set, export, shape, status or code moves)

## What this does

PR #24454 moved the spec's source sentences to objectstack-ai/cloud#3002 ruling A, as triage applied it (`6250167038` on #24327, `6252585695` on #24368):

- a set "made here, not from a package" reads "authored in this system";
- "the system the caller is in" drops the noun, or says "this system";
- a string that means a deployment or configuration scope keeps its word.

This PR makes the client SDK, the hand-written docs and the three translated bundles match it. It also qualifies the `/ai/models` decision citation as `cloud ADR-0028` (Prime Directive #13).

## Per-string reading

Line numbers are on base `31ce45c07`. "Clause 1/2/3" are the three bullets above, in order.

| site | before | after, or kept: reason |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/client/src/index.ts:6702`, TSDoc of `ai.models()` (ships in the `.d.ts`) | Models this environment offers in the chat model picker (ADR-0028) | Models this system offers in the chat model picker (cloud ADR-0028). Clause 2: the system the caller asks. This is the spec's `AiModelsResponse.models` describe as PR #24454 left it. The citation is qualified, see below |

Clause 1: set against "a package's declaration" |

Clause 1: set against "a set that ships with an installed package/app" |

| `ja-JP.metadata-forms.generated.ts:2337`, same key | ... この環境で作成したセットでは空のままにします。 | ... このシステムで作成したセットでは空のままにします。 Same |

The method addresses `/api/v1/cloud/environments/:id` on the control plane. "this environment" is the one `id` names, one environment among several |
| `index.ts:3353`, TSDoc of `environments.rotateCredential(id, ...)` | Rotate the active database credential for this environment. | **kept**: the same control-plane route family and the same scope |

| `index.ts:7816-7817`, `:7852-7853`, TSDoc of the environment-scoped metadata client's `deleteItem` and `history` (each wrapped) | ... scoped to this environment. | **kept**: configuration scope. This is the scoped client's `/environments/:environmentId` mount, set against its unscoped twin in the same sentence |
| `permission-sets.mdx:380`, the edit consequence's lead | **A set shipped in code cannot be edited in the environment.** | **A set shipped in code cannot be edited in this system.** Clause 2: the running system, in the same consequence list as `:387`'s "one authored in this system" |
| `permission-sets.mdx:394-395`, the delete consequence (wrapped) | A set that ships with an installed package/app cannot be removed from the environment: its definition stays served from the package. | ... cannot be removed from this system: ... Clause 2: it follows "A set authored in this system is removed." in the same bullet |
| `authentication.mdx:268-269`, the bootstrap-status fail-open sentence (wrapped) | ... rather than offering to create an owner on an environment that may already have one. | ... rather than offering to create an owner when one may already exist. Clause 2, with the noun dropped: the same running system `:252` names in this section |
| `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx:395`, the comment on the `ai.models()` example | // plan-filtered picker list (ADR-0028) | // plan-filtered picker list (cloud ADR-0028). The same qualification as the TSDoc and the `plugin-endpoints.mdx` row; see the next section |
| `permission-sets.mdx:239`, how a position's `permissionSets` resolve | Each name in `permissionSets` is resolved in the environment's catalog | **kept**: the spec calls the same lookup "the environment catalog" (`packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts:16`, `:93`, `:107`), and PR #24454 left it |
| `permission-sets.mdx:374`, `:401` | `?scope=environment`; "environment metadata under `single`" | **kept**: configuration scope. Both name the ADR-0131 environment scope, as against an organization's |
| `permission-sets.mdx:345`, `:350`, `:360`, `:421` | "package vs environment sets", "environment-authored sets", "An environment write", "Environment-authored sets", "environment-authored set" | **kept**: "environment-authored" is the documented name of the provenance class, which the spec also keeps (`permission-set-owner-binding.ts:103`). The `:345` heading and `:350` use the same class vocabulary. This round's census found those two beyond the seat's list; they are kept for the same reason |

The translations keep each locale's verb. 创建, 作成 and creado are the usual words in those locales for making a record here, which is the sense the class names. Only the noun moves, to the words this family's earlier translations chose: 本系统 / このシステム / este sistema (PR #24432).

## The `ADR-0028` citation: read as cloud's

- This registry's `docs/adr/0028-metadata-naming-and-namespace-isolation.md` is "Metadata Naming & Namespace Isolation". It says nothing about models, plans or a picker.
- `/ai/models` is served by `service-ai`, which this repository does not ship. `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx` says "`service-ai` (chat, completion, models, conversations) is Cloud/EE". The v17.0.0 entry that introduced `ai.models()` together with this citation (`packages/client/CHANGELOG.md`, changeset `8b9d71e`) says "`service-ai` is a Cloud/EE package in the `cloud` repo". Plan policy also stays server-side in cloud (`packages/cloud-connection/package.json`, cloud ADR-0008).
- This session could not read cloud's own registry. `add_repo` for objectstack-ai/cloud answered "you don't have access". So this PR does not confirm cloud ADR-0028's title. The qualification rests on two facts: this registry's 0028 is unrelated, and the code the citation governs lives in cloud.
- `scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` recognises the `cloud ADR-` qualifier and skips it (`CROSS_REPO_QUALIFIERS`).

## Translations and their source-hash record

None of the three leaves has a recorded source hash, so no hash moves:

- `grep -c metadataForms` over the six `*.source-hashes.ts` / `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` files answers 0 for each.
- A generated-section table carries an entry only while the leaf is a byte copy of its source (`source-hash.ts`, `GENERATED_SECTIONS`, and each table's header). These three leaves are translations, so each is legacy-trusted.
- `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` ran on the edited tree and exited 0. It rewrote every bundle file (mtimes moved to the run), and `git status --porcelain` stayed empty afterwards. The generator kept all three hand values and wrote no hash entry.
- No key was added or dropped.

## Changeset

`.changeset/24456-client-platform-objects-this-system.md` is a `patch` for `@objectstack/client` and `@objectstack/platform-objects`. Both publish (`private` unset, and `files` ships `dist`). The TSDoc reaches the client's `.d.ts`, and the bundles reach platform-objects' `dist`. The docs pages publish nothing.

## Verification

Every reading is at HEAD `3becd9711` on base `31ce45c07`, unless it is marked as taken at `1fd900cfd`. The second commit, `3becd9711`, changes three hand-written docs pages and no package file (`git diff --stat 1fd900cfd 3becd9711`). So the typecheck, test and i18n `--write` readings taken at `1fd900cfd` cover the same package bytes. Each exit code was captured before any pipe.

- Build: `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs --concurrency=2` through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. At `1fd900cfd`: `Tasks: 76 successful, 76 total`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. At `3becd9711`, in a recreated worktree: `Tasks: 76 successful, 76 total`, `Cached: 76 cached, 76 total` (FULL TURBO), `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Typecheck, at `1fd900cfd`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck` exited 0 (`VERDICT command-exit 0`), with `check:test-typecheck: OK` for both.

- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `3becd9711` (9 paths) derived 90 commands, the same 90 as at `1fd900cfd`, and all 90 exited 0. The reconciliation `--ran` answered "Run reconciliation — 90 derived, 90 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". Among them:

  - `pnpm check:dts-closure`: 178/178 present.
- I also ran the 11 declared-wide families and the 4 artifact-roster families whose roster sits under a path of this diff (`check-changeset-fixed`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`). All 15 exited 0, at both heads.
- Control-byte self-scan over the 9 changed files at `3becd9711`: no hits.
- No ablation and no reverse verification: the diff changes copy only, and no test pins any old sentence. `git grep -F` finds each old sentence only at its own site.
- Not run locally: `test:repo` (CI `Test Core`), and the 6 families that take a value from the workflow (CI only).

## Acceptance notes

None of these is this card's to move. Carrier for each: none, unless named.

- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts:3359` and `:3362` cite a bare `ADR-0028` beside `/ai/models` ("the environment's plan-filtered picker list (ADR-0028)", "the ADR-0028 allowlist"). Spec is `domain:spec`'s and on hold here. The same `:3359` line and `:3371` ("Whether this is the environment default") keep "environment", as PR #24454 read them: the deployment's plan-scoped list and its configured default.
